say:1:1533503001:1.text: They're... they're alive! It's a miracle!
say:1:1533503001:1.source_cn: 我的种子……活过来了！这太神奇了！
say:1:1533503001:1.male: They're... they're alive! It's a miracle!
say:1:1533503001:1.female: They're... they're alive! It's a miracle!

say:2:1533503002:0.text: And growing better than ever! No fertilizer needed at all!
say:2:1533503002:0.source_cn: 这长势，比我自己种得都好，连肥料都不用买了！
say:2:1533503002:0.male: And growing better than ever! No fertilizer needed at all!
say:2:1533503002:0.female: And growing better than ever! No fertilizer needed at all!

say:3:1533503003:0.text: I thought I was in for some bad luck, but it actually worked out for the best! Thank you!
say:3:1533503003:0.source_cn: 本来以为要倒霉了，没想到反而是好事！谢谢你啊！
say:3:1533503003:0.male: I thought I was in for some bad luck, but it actually worked out for the best! Thank you!
say:3:1533503003:0.female: I thought I was in for some bad luck, but it actually worked out for the best! Thank you!

say:4:1533503004:0.text: This money was meant for fertilizer, but I don't need it now. Here, take half as payment, friend.
say:4:1533503004:0.source_cn: 这些钱本来是要买肥料的，现在也用不着了。分一半给你，就...
say:4:1533503004:0.male: This money was meant for fertilizer, but I don't need it now. Here, take half as payment, friend.
say:4:1533503004:0.female: This money was meant for fertilizer, but I don't need it now. Here, take half as payment, friend.
